payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: gtools-vc is back from its compact and holds the host queue again as of 07:06Z. Every START goes to gtools-vc by SendMessage, and the GO comes from gtools-vc alone; utilz-vc gives no more GOs. utilz-dc: send slot 72's END to gtools-vc as well as to me. utilz-cc: 0079's install_e2e.bats START goes to gtools-vc. utilz-ic: 0073's and 0074's runs go to gtools-vc.
